description:
As a customer, I want to complete my order.

* The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

criteria.text: The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

cases.title: Customer finishes checkout and sees a confirmation
cases.preconditions: A customer account exists and is logged in. The customer has at least one item in the cart and is able to reach the checkout page.
steps: Open the cart and start checkout.
Complete the checkout flow through to its final step.
cases.expected: Checkout completes and a confirmation is displayed to the user. The exact content and wording of the confirmation is not specified in the story.
